name: Tool Manifest RBAC Filter
description: Inspects and filters agent tool definitions (function call manifest) based on user roles and allowed tool lists before dispatching to the LLM.

fields.name: allowed_tools
fields.label: Allowed Tool Names
fields.helperText: Comma-separated list of allowed tool names (e.g. 'get_weather, search_docs') or '*' for all.

fields.name: blocked_tools
fields.label: Blocked Tool Names
fields.helperText: Comma-separated list of tool names to strip from the agent manifest.
